scientific_integrity: Proof is complete for the asserted finite abelian domains. Finite numerical experiments corroborate rather than certify the universal statement; historical-priority comparison is bounded.
scientific_limitations: One equal-coefficient checksum equation and a complete Hamming frequency ball only; no general code parity matrix, arbitrary observation weights or decoder. Possible equivalent older code-weight-enumerator formulation is not ruled out.
title: Exact alias spectra and the binary Nyquist boundary for parity-check Fourier sampling
